whatsapp_label: Chat with the tutor on WhatsApp
whatsapp_prefill: Hi, I found you on Tutora and I'd like to ask about lessons.
signup_lead: It takes one minute. We will email you a link to confirm your address.
field_phone_hint: For lesson reminders on WhatsApp. Example: +263 77 123 4567
parent_section_lead: Required for students under 18. We only use it for lessons, payments and safety.
field_consent: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy notice.
verify_lead: We sent a link to {email}. Tap it to confirm your address, then you can log in.
verify_lead_generic: We sent you a link. Tap it to confirm your address, then you can log in.
verify_spam: Can't find it? Look in your spam or promotions folder.
login_unverified: Please confirm your email first, using the link we sent you. Can't find it? Use "Forgot your password?" to get a new link.
twofa_login_lead: Open your authenticator app and type the code for Tutora.
twofa_use_backup: Lost your phone? Use a backup code
forgot_lead: Enter your email. If you have an account, we will send a reset link.
forgot_sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.
reset_done: Your password has been changed. Please log in.
reset_invalid: This reset link is not valid or has expired. Please ask for a new one.
twofa_required: The tutor area needs two-step verification. This protects students' details and payments.
twofa_setup_lead: You will need an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator (free).
twofa_step2: 2. Scan this QR code with the app, or type the key by hand.
twofa_step3: 3. Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofa_backup_lead: Write these down and keep them somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.
twofa_disable_tutor_note: The tutor account must keep two-step verification on.
setup_lead: For the tutor only. Type your email address and we will send you a link to choose your password.
setup_sent: If this is the tutor's address, a link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.
setup_done: The tutor account is already set up. Please log in.
tutor_lead: Your Today screen, bookings, calendar and payments will appear here.
student_lead: Your bookings, lessons, payments and homework will appear here.
draft_notice: Draft. This text will be reviewed before launch.
err_email: Please enter a valid email address.
err_phone: Please enter a valid phone number, for example +263 77 123 4567.
err_password_short: Password must be at least 10 characters.
err_password_match: The two passwords do not match.
err_consent: Please agree to the Terms and Privacy notice.
err_code: Please enter the code exactly as shown.
err_code_wrong: That code did not work. Please try again.
err_login: Email or password is not correct.
err_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in.
err_rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_use_tutor_setup: This is the tutor's email address. Please use the tutor set-up page instead.
ask_price_note: Ask the tutor for prices on WhatsApp or after booking.
book_footer: The tutor will accept, decline or suggest another time. You will get an email.
book_no_times: There are no free times right now. Please check again later or message the tutor.
book_not_ready: Booking opens soon. Please check again later.
cancel_lesson_lead: Everyone booked will get an email. Their charge for this lesson is removed, or their package lesson is given back.
cancel_too_late: Less than {hours} hours to go: please message the tutor to cancel.
cash_lead: Tap this after giving cash to the tutor. They will confirm it and you will get a receipt.
coming_soon_lead: This tutor's page is being set up. Please come back soon.
credit: You have {amount} credit. It will be used for your next lessons.
done_accepted: Accepted. The student gets an email, and the lesson is in your calendar.
done_declined: Declined. The student has been told.
done_rejected: Payment rejected. The student has been told why.
err_answer_empty: Please add a file or a note.
err_cancel_late: It is too late to cancel online. Please message the tutor.
err_email_same: Could not change to that email. Please check it and try again.
err_file_type: Please use a JPG, PNG, WebP photo or a PDF.
err_future_date: The date can't be in the future.
err_group_full: That group lesson is full or no longer available.
err_mode: That type of lesson isn't offered.
err_money: Please enter an amount, for example 8 or 12.50.
err_number: Please enter a number in the allowed range.
err_package: That package is no longer available.
err_photo_big: This photo is too big. Please choose a smaller photo (under 400 KB).
err_review_not_allowed: You can review after your first lesson.
err_review_short: Please write a few more words.
err_slot_taken: Sorry, that time is no longer free. Please choose another.
err_tick_sure: Please tick the box to confirm.
err_too_many_requests: You already have several requests waiting. Please wait for the tutor to answer.
file_hint_5mb: PDF or photo, up to 5 MB.
handed_in: Handed in. The tutor can see it now.
home_meta: Private tutoring: book a lesson online or in person.
intro_lead: A free 15-minute chat to meet the tutor and talk about what you need.
more_settings_hint: Change anything, including your login email
more_wizard_hint: Go through the setup steps again
no_pay_details: The tutor hasn't added payment details yet. Please ask them how to pay.
package_counts_down: Counts down by one for each lesson
package_how: Choosing a package adds its price to what you owe. Your next lessons use its credits.
pdone_cash: Thank you. The tutor will confirm your cash payment.
pdone_package: Package added. Your next lessons will use it.
pdone_sent: Sent. The tutor will check it, then you get a receipt.
private_note_hint: What went well, what to practise…
proof: Screenshot or photo of the payment
proof_hint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 3 MB. Photos are made smaller and location data is removed.
record_cash_where: To record cash you received, open the student's page.
reference_hint: From the SMS or bank slip.
results_privacy: Shown with permission. First names or initials only.
review_after_lesson: You can leave a review after your first lesson.
review_lead: Your review shows your first name only. The tutor can hide reviews but cannot change them.
reviews_note: Only students who had a lesson can leave a review.
reviews_tutor_lead: You can hide abusive reviews. You can't change what people wrote.
room_data_note: Audio and whiteboard only, to save data (about 15–25 MB per hour). You can turn on video if needed.
room_mic_error: Microphone not allowed. Check your phone settings; you can still use the whiteboard and chat.
room_opens_soon: The room opens 30 minutes before the lesson.
room_ready_lead: Tap the button to start. Your phone will ask to use the microphone.
room_share_file: Share a PDF or photo (max 5 MB)
room_waiting: Waiting for the tutor to let you in…
room_waiting_lead: Only students booked on this lesson can join. Keep this page open.
sdone_cancelled: Lesson cancelled. The tutor has been told.
sec_account_hint: Change your login email, password or two-step verification
sec_contact_hint: WhatsApp, phone and email shown on your page
sec_prices_hint: Lesson prices, show or hide, currency, packages
sec_teaching_hint: One-to-one or groups, online or in person
sec_times_hint: When students can book, lesson length, cancellations
set_contact_email_hint: Shown on your public page. Can be different from your login email.
set_default_price_hint: Used for subjects without their own price.
set_email_changed: Your login email has been changed.
set_email_sent: We sent a link to {email}. Your login email changes when you tap it.
set_headline_hint: e.g. Clear, patient Maths lessons that get results
set_levels_hint: e.g. Grade 7, O Level, A Level (ZIMSEC / Cambridge)
set_name_hint: As students should see it, e.g. Mr T. Moyo
set_new_email_hint: We send a link to the new address. Nothing changes until you tap it.
set_packages_lead: For example 4 lessons for a lower price. Each lesson uses one credit.
set_password_lead: To change your password we email you a link.
set_pay_lead: Only logged-in students and parents see these. Leave empty what you don't use.
set_photo_hint: A clear face photo. It is made small (about 20 KB) so it loads fast.
set_results_consent: I have permission to show these results. Only first names or initials are used.
set_results_lead: Results appear on your page only when the permission box below is ticked.
set_subject_price_hint: Leave empty to use your normal price.
set_subjects_empty: No subjects yet. Add your first subject below.
set_subjects_lead: Add each subject you teach and its levels.
set_times_lead: Students can only book inside these times. Untick days you don't teach.
set_whatsapp_hint: Shown as a green button on your page. Leave empty to hide it.
settings_rerun_wizard: Go through the setup steps again
student_says_cash: The student says they paid cash.
subject: Subject
title: Title
today_setup_lead: {n} parts still empty. Tap to finish setting up.
where_both: Online from anywhere, or in person ({town}).
wiz_done_lead: You can change anything later in Settings.
wiz_welcome_hidden: Anything you leave empty is hidden from your public page.
wiz_welcome_lead: Let's set up your page and bookings. It takes about 10 minutes. You can skip any step and finish later in Settings.
field_child_name_hint: The student who will have the lessons.

email_hw_in_b: {name} handed in homework. Open their page on Tutora to see it.

email_cash_new_b: {name} says they paid you {amount} in cash on {date}. Open Tutora to confirm.
email_lesson_cancel_b: The tutor had to cancel the lesson on {when}. Any charge for it has been removed. Please book another time on Tutora.
email_cash_rec_b: The tutor recorded your cash payment of {amount}. Your receipt is under "Payments" on Tutora.

Sorry, the tutor can't do {when}.{extra}
You can choose another time on Tutora.
email_proposed_b:
The tutor suggests {when} instead.{extra}
Open Tutora to accept or say no.
email_confirmed_b: The tutor confirmed your payment of {amount}. Your receipt is under "Payments" on Tutora.
email_rejected_b:
The tutor could not confirm your payment of {amount}.{extra}
Please check and send it again, or message the tutor.
email_reset_b:
Hello {name},

Tap this link to choose a new password:
{url}

The link expires in 1 hour. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
email_verify_b:
Hello {name},

Tap this link to confirm your email address:
{url}

If you did not sign up for Tutora, you can ignore this email.
email_exists_s: Someone tried to sign up to Tutora with your email
email_exists_b:
Hello,

Someone just tried to create a Tutora account with this email address, which already has an account.

If it was you and you forgot your password, reset it here:
{url}

If it was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not been changed.
email_remind_b:
Hello {name},

This is a reminder of your {subject} lesson on {when} (Zimbabwe time).
{where}

See you then!
pdf_thanks: Confirmed by the tutor. Thank you!
